repair_snapshot.label: Risk
repair_snapshot.value: Thread damage, seized plugs, repeat misfire

repair_snapshot.label: Decision
repair_snapshot.value: Inspect coils and plug wells before parts quote

critical_checks: Confirm engine family and plug style before ordering.
Inspect coil boots for carbon tracking and oil contamination.
Blow debris from plug wells before loosening plugs.
Check misfire counters before and after service.
known_failure_patterns: High-mileage plugs may be tight in aluminum threads.
Weak or carbon-tracked coil boots can mimic plug failure.
Oil in plug wells points to valve cover or tube seal concerns.
inspection_opportunities: Valve cover gasket and plug well seals
recommended_parts: Coil boots if brittle or carbon tracked
Intake or access gaskets if removed

torque_specs.value: Verify by plug design and cylinder head service data

repair_snapshot.label: Risk
repair_snapshot.value: Misdiagnosing cooling, ignition, or leak source

repair_snapshot.label: Decision
repair_snapshot.value: Evidence package before major engine quote

critical_checks: Pressure-test cooling system hot and cold.
Check for combustion gas evidence in cooling system.
Inspect oil and coolant for cross-contamination.
Review overheating history and cooling fan operation.
Perform cylinder-specific leak-down or borescope check when indicated.
known_failure_patterns: Overheating events can create secondary gasket or deck concerns.
External leaks may imitate coolant-loss head gasket symptoms.
Misfire on startup can point to cylinder coolant intrusion.
required_parts: Diagnostic test fluid or tools as needed
recommended_parts: Cooling system pressure cap if weak

torque_specs.label: Head fasteners
torque_specs.value: Do not quote from memory; verify if teardown is approved

torque_specs.label: Cooling pressure
torque_specs.value: Use cap/system rating from vehicle data

notes: Evaluation snapshot only. Keep separate from teardown procedure and final repair authorization.

critical_checks: Measure inner and outer pad thickness on both front wheels.
Inspect rotors for grooves, heat spots, thickness, and pulsation complaint.
Check slide pins, boots, caliper piston boot, and hose condition.
Confirm brake package before ordering parts.
known_failure_patterns: Dry slide pins can cause tapered wear.
Reused hardware can contribute to noise.
Rotor condition often determines whether pad-only work is appropriate.
inspection_opportunities: Tire wear and front suspension play
recommended_parts: Front rotors if below spec, grooved, or pulsating

torque_specs.label: Wheel lug nuts
torque_specs.value: Verify wheel torque by wheel type

notes: Decision-support snapshot. Confirm rotor measurements and exact torque values before completion.

repair_snapshot.label: Decision
repair_snapshot.value: Confirm viscosity and filter before service

critical_checks: Confirm oil viscosity, capacity, and filter style.
Inspect drain plug threads and sealing washer.
Check for existing oil leaks before draining.
Verify maintenance reminder reset need.
known_failure_patterns: Plastic filter housings can crack if overtightened.
Missing undertray fasteners add time and comeback risk.
visual_layout:
SERVICE PATH
Top Side: Fill cap - Dipstick - Filter if top-mounted
Underside: Drain plug - Filter if bottom-mounted - Leak check
RESET REMINDER IF EQUIPPED
notes: Generic snapshot applies when no more specific oil service intelligence exists.

critical_checks: Test battery state of charge and health.
Inspect terminals, hold-down, tray, and cable ends.
Confirm group size, CCA, AGM/EFB requirement, and venting.
Check charging voltage after replacement.
Confirm registration or BMS reset requirement.
known_failure_patterns: Corroded terminals create repeat no-start complaints.
Weak alternator output can look like battery failure.
Modern battery monitoring systems may need reset.
inspection_opportunities: Parasitic draw if repeated dead battery
special_tools: Scan tool when registration is required
visual_layout:
BATTERY AREA
Positive Terminal: cover and main feed
Negative Terminal: body/engine ground path
Hold-down: clamp or bracket
VERIFY VENT TUBE IF EQUIPPED
notes: Generic snapshot applies across vehicles; verify battery registration needs by model.
